title: Penetration Testing Cost in 2026: Prices by Scope
summary: A web app pen test from Agency is $5,000 fixed in 2026. Add-on prices, delivery times, and what moves cost for API, network, cloud and mobile scopes.
body_markdown:
## What does a penetration test cost by scope?


Scope sets the price. Testing one web application is a different job from testing an API, an internet-facing network range, a cloud environment or a mobile app, and each is priced on its own. The table puts Agency's posted price beside market prices for each scope: Agency's own opinion of the market where it has one, and public records of what government buyers paid or were quoted.


What does a penetration test cost by scope? — comparison Scope What is tested Agency's posted price Market prices


Web application One production web app, tested by hand with the accounts you provide $5,000 fixed ([Agency pricing](https://getagency.com/pen-testing/pricing?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=pentest&utm_content=penetration-testing-cost__in_text) ) About $17,500 (Agency's opinion of the market for the same scope); $800 to $89,700 per application across 12 vendors on a state price list, median $9,550 by Agency's calculation ([Mississippi ITS](https://www.its.ms.gov/node/86) ); £12,936 for one web app ([UK National Archives, May 2026](https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/Notice/00013afa-1f56-44a1-8efd-a99a91e27a7a) )


API The endpoints, authentication and authorization behind the web app +$2,500 add-on ([Agency pricing](https://getagency.com/pen-testing/pricing?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=pentest&utm_content=penetration-testing-cost__in_text) ) About $8,750 (Agency's opinion of the market); £9,600 for a web application and its API ([Kent County Council, June 2026](https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/Notice/30f5d119-551e-42e8-bc33-2bffd0750127) )


External network Internet-facing hosts and services Scoped by quote $3,600 for 25 IP addresses, with the retest priced at another $3,600 ([North Florida College, March 2025](https://nfc.edu/about/board-of-trustees/12-A-Security%20Compliance%20Agreement.pdf) )


Cloud environment A cloud account or hosted environment Scoped by quote £9,643.20 for an AWS environment ([Post Office, June 2025](https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/Notice/0cd6f851-6a9d-4b0a-b495-d575a65df92b) ); £17,201 for an Azure Virtual Desktop health check ([Ministry of Defence, January 2026](https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/Notice/670f980e-06d2-4158-b41f-cb9176cacad0) )


Mobile app An iOS or Android application Scoped by quote £52,500 for web and mobile application testing together ([UK Health Security Agency, July 2023](https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/Notice/e0626bb8-1b65-4a8e-8f3e-eae50e72b45b) )


Read the public records in the right-hand column as individual records, not averages. The Mississippi figures are the per-application prices that 12 approved vendors list for a state contract, and they span two orders of magnitude. The UK figures are single contract awards, and most notices do not state how many applications, addresses or tester days were bought.


The figures marked as Agency's opinion of the market are Agency's own view of what the same scope costs elsewhere, not a published survey.


Three provider models sit behind those prices. A fixed-price product posts one price for a defined scope. A quote-based firm prices after a scoping call. An automated or AI testing service is sold by subscription, and the amount of human review varies by vendor. Compare them on who tests, what is in scope and what the report contains before comparing totals.


Agency estimates that more than 90% of its web app penetration test orders are for the web app alone, without the API add-on.


## What is included in Agency's fixed price?


The product is the Web App Penetration Test for Compliance. Agency's[pen testing page](https://getagency.com/lp/pen-testing-compliance?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=pentest&utm_content=penetration-testing-cost__in_text) lists what the fixed price covers:


- One production web application, on one domain or URL route.
- Manual, authenticated testing with the test accounts you provide.
- Named individual testers holding OSCP+ and CREST certifications.
- A signed report that lists the testers who did the work.
- An attestation letter you can share in place of the full report.
- Follow-up questions and discussion about the findings.


Four add-ons carry posted prices. You select them on the order request.


What is included in Agency's fixed price? — comparison Add-on Posted price What it adds Source


API testing +$2,500 Direct testing of the API behind the web application[Agency pricing](https://getagency.com/pen-testing/pricing?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=pentest&utm_content=penetration-testing-cost__in_text)


Rush delivery +$3,000 The report in as little as 5 days from start[Agency pricing](https://getagency.com/pen-testing/pricing?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=pentest&utm_content=penetration-testing-cost__in_text)


Additional web app +$2,500 One more web application in the same engagement[Agency pricing](https://getagency.com/pen-testing/pricing?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=pentest&utm_content=penetration-testing-cost__in_text)


Retest +$2,000 One retest of the findings you fixed, within 30 days of the report[Agency pricing](https://getagency.com/pen-testing/pricing?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=pentest&utm_content=penetration-testing-cost__in_text)


Standard delivery is 21 days on average from start, and rush delivery is as little as 5 days from start, per[the order page](https://getagency.com/pen-testing/order?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=pentest&utm_content=penetration-testing-cost__in_text) . Start is the day Agency has received payment, test credentials and the signed rules of engagement.


Mobile apps, network testing, cloud configuration review, source code review and social engineering are outside the product. Agency scopes those by quote.
